build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a ball that must pass through holes in bars
create_bar_with_hole: create static bars with a configurable hole using the _bar_with_hole helper function
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the scene with a specified scale and position
update_task_relationships: update the task goal to require the ball touching the bottom wall
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to indicate a TWO_BALLS solution tier is required
